locales.name: Spanish
locales.register: Use neutral international Spanish, concise infinitive action labels and polite usted when direct address is necessary; avoid region-specific slang and vosotros.

locales.name: Italian
locales.register: Use concise natural Italian, infinitive action labels and impersonal instructions; avoid mixing tu and Lei.

locales.name: Brazilian Portuguese
locales.register: Use Brazilian Portuguese, concise action labels and consistent você/seu when addressing the user; use Brazilian software terminology rather than European Portuguese.

locales.name: Dutch
locales.register: Use concise natural Dutch and consistent je/jouw when addressing the user; use normal Dutch software terminology.

locales.name: Swedish
locales.register: Use concise natural Swedish and consistent du/din when addressing the user; keep compound words natural.

locales.name: Danish
locales.register: Use concise natural Danish and consistent du/din when addressing the user; use ordinary Danish software terminology.

locales.name: Czech
locales.register: Use natural Czech with concise action labels and polite plural vy when needed; avoid gender assumptions and preserve all target plural distinctions.

locales.name: Polish
locales.register: Use natural Polish, concise conventional action labels and impersonal instructions; avoid unnecessary pronouns and gender assumptions.

locales.name: Romanian
locales.register: Use natural Romanian with diacritics, concise conventional action labels and impersonal instructions; use consistent polite wording when direct address is necessary.

locales.name: Russian
locales.register: Use natural Russian with concise action labels and polite lowercase вы when needed; preserve zero, singular, few and many count distinctions.

locales.name: Ukrainian
locales.register: Use natural Ukrainian terminology and spelling, concise action labels and polite lowercase ви when needed; avoid Russian calques.

locales.name: Turkish
locales.register: Use concise natural Turkish and consistent polite or impersonal instructions; respect Turkish dotted and dotless I and natural suffixes around placeholders.

locales.name: Japanese
locales.register: Use natural Japanese, concise conventional noun/action labels and consistent polite です/ます sentences; avoid unnecessary personal pronouns and unnatural literal loanwords.

locales.name: Korean
locales.register: Use natural Korean, concise conventional noun/action labels and consistent formal polite 합니다/하십시오 sentences; choose natural particles around placeholders.

locales.name: Simplified Chinese
locales.register: Use Simplified Chinese and mainland software terminology, concise action labels and neutral instructions; use 您 only when necessary and never mix Traditional characters.

locales.name: Traditional Chinese
locales.register: Use Traditional Chinese with Taiwan software terminology such as 檔案 and 資料夾, concise labels and neutral instructions; never mix Simplified characters.
